'''Narl''' was an individual who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Captain Narl worked as a pilot for the [[GeneTech Syndicate]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Though the group is divided, the Captain has decided to take the fight to the creatures. We're setting off to follow the trail and see if we can beat the creatures at their source|A journal entry|<ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Evolution|Talus}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Narl [[Captain/Legends|captained]] a [[Transport/Legends|transport ship]]<ref name="SWG:TtC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Tracking the Crew|Talus}}</ref> for the GeneTech Syndicate, a biotechnology company based on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG:G" />

[[File:Arachne_crash_site.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Captain Narl's crashed ship.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Captain Narl was ordered to transport a group of scientists<ref name="SWG:TtC" /> and a cargo of [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] [[arachne]]s.<ref name="SWG:RO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Rescue Operation|Talus}}</ref> Those arachnes were [[bioweapon]]s secretly designed by the GeneTech Syndicate as the [[Parasophic Arachne]] program.<ref name="SWG:G" /> The destination was the [[Imperial research facility (Nubia)|Imperial research facility]] on [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]].<ref name="GP">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66911&resource=features|text=Genetic Potential}}</ref> However, during the trip, the ship's anti-grav and thruster control broke down and the vessel plowed into the side of a Talusian mountain, northeast of the city of [[Nashal]]. After the crash, Captain Narl organized the survivors in two group. One group was tasked with taking care of the wounded, establishing a camp and finding a way to get to Nashal. The second group was tasked with destroying any of the creatures that broke out of containment and escaped. The scientists aboard the ship were carrying a highly contagious virus designed to destroy the entire shipment of arachnes if necessary.<ref name="SWG:RO" /> However, the arachnes quickly molted into more powerful and intelligent creatures and completely overwhelmed the survivors. The ship's crew did their best to protect the scientists and the wounded but the arachne took one or two more of them every night. Captain Narl then issued [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking emitters]] for everyone to wear and gave the tracking device to his droid [[CV-4T]]. The survivors later established another camp on their road to Nashal while the Captain and some others went in search of the missing crew.<ref name="SWG:TtC" /> Captain Narl decided to take the fight to the creatures and the group followed a trail of blood in order to beat the creatures at their source.<ref name="SWG:E" /> The group followed and fought the arachnes in several caves in the mountains.<ref name="SWG:TtC" /><ref name="SWG:E" /> However, the creatures had already grown to their fifth life stage, progressing far faster than anticipated and exhibiting new special attack features and intelligence. The creatures finally trapped the survivors in a cave and Captain Narl died trying to protect his men.<ref name="SWG:GD" />

[[File:Captain_Narl.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Remains of Captain Narl and his crew.]]
In the meantime, the [[Corellian Security Force]] spotted the crash of Captain Narl's ship. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]] dispatched a spacer to investigate the crash site in the mountains and rescue any survivors.<ref name="SWG:RO" /> The spacer visited all the survivors' camps and arachnes' lairs but only found dead bodies.<ref name="SWG:TtC" /><ref name="SWG:E" /> The spacer finally discovered that Captain Narl and all the other survivors were already been killed by the arachnes.<ref name="SWG:GD" /> This eventually led to the discovery of the Parasophic Arachne program, leading to a CorSec raid on the [[GeneTech Syndicate Lab]].<ref name="SWG:G" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Narl was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TtC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Captain Narl was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Rescue Operation|Genetic Potential]]" arc with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
